title: The Exemption
summary: Promoter essay arguing the 1933 gold seizure and HJR 192 made citizens creditors of the government holding an 'exemption' they can use to discharge debts.

assertions.quote: As a result of HJR 192, the people can no longer pay their debts.
are terms referring to legal fictions, or a straw man
Since the Executive Order applies to individuals and persons, by necessity, it did not apply to men.

verdicts.note: Appellate court: a 'flesh-and-blood human being' or 'sovereign citizen' is not beyond the courts' jurisdiction, and such theories 'should be rejected summarily, however they are presented'.
Dove's claim that Meads cannot reach 'human beings' as opposed to the Strawman 'person' was argued in court by him and followers without success, up to the Federal Court of Appeal.
The Tax Court rejected a man-versus-person duality argument because 'this alleged duality does not exist'; the author says there is no possible legal response other than calling it spurious.
'Living man' and 'sovereign man' habeas petitions and appeals in NZ all failed; the courts held the natural person is identified by the legal name.
Under modern Canadian law it is impossible to renounce legal-person status, and the SCC denied leave to these arguments.

assertions.quote: the government owes us a huge debt which we call our exemption

verdicts.note: There is no exemption account; bills of exchange and similar instruments drawn on it are rejected and have led to fraud convictions.
The claim that a person can use the government's supposed debt to her to discharge debts to third parties by a bill of exchange was rejected; the tender was worthless and the foreclosure was lawful.

assertions.quote: the government has created an enormous amount of money from each of us

verdicts.note: Money is created by bank lending and Federal Reserve operations, not issued against individual Social Security numbers; the FOIA story is unverified.
Treasury: there is no monetary value to a birth certificate or social security number, and TreasuryDirect accounts only hold what the owner funds from their own bank account.
The notion of secret Treasury accounts assigned to each citizen is called pure fantasy; the Treasury keeps no such accounts.
The SCC has implicitly rejected the idea that governments run secret bank accounts tied to each person that can be reached by exotic means.

assertions.quote: One who holds property as fee simple or in allodium would pay no property taxes.

verdicts.note: Fee simple land is taxed everywhere in the US and courts and attorneys general reject allodial-title tax exemptions.
